name: Where is my ship?!
detailed_description:
Welcome to "Where is my ship?!"

in this first person precision platformer you will play as a small intruder trying to escape a humans home.

Story

You and your crew entered a humans home through a window to find food to survive. While trying to get some food the Human thought there were bugs on the food and through it into the trash. You and your friends fell down. Your crew tried to build a way to the top to escape the humans home with your ship.

After the parkour is build, your crew ist trying to escape. You failed your last jump and fell down again. Are you able to jump back to the top and find your ship?

This Game is inspired by only up, getting over it and jump king. 

Jump to the top with your jump strength.

Gameplay

Play in multiple ways.

Easy 

In this mode you are able to control your jumps while in the air to adjust your landing. 

Use Space to jump, hold space to strengthen your jump and Right Click to reset the loading jump strength.

Intended

In this mode you are cannot control your jumps while in the air. 

Use Space to jump, hold space to strengthen your jump and Right Click to reset the loading jump strength.

Training

In this mode you are cannot control your jumps while in the air. 

Usethe mouse wheel to use the jump strength you want to use to train specific jumps.

Easy - Air Load

In this mode you are able to control your jumps while in the air to adjust your landing and you are able to strengthen your next jump while in the air. But you are only be able to jump while on the ground.

Use Space to jump, hold space to strengthen your jump and Right Click to reset the loading jump strength.

Intended - Load

In this mode you are cannot control your jumps while in the air and you are able to strengthen your next jump while in the air. But you are only be able to jump while on the ground.

Use Space to jump, hold space to strengthen your jump and Right Click to reset the loading jump strength.

There will be a Multiplayer Update in a future Version of the game. Stay tuned for that.

Controls

W A S D - Move

SPACE - Jump

Hold Space and release -  Strengthen the jump

Right Click - Reset the jump strength

While using fly mode through the dev console:

W A S D - Move

SPACE - fly up

Control - fly down

Unfortunatly there is no save system in this version

There is a dev console in the game to teleport to specific checkpoints, because there is no Save system in the game as of now. But no worries, i am woriking on a save system.

Dev Console 

Use the button over the tab button to open the dev console. (^ or ' i think, depends on the keyboard).

Commands:

tp[number] to teleport to the used number small checkpoint (Small Toasts)

cptp[number] to teleport to the used number big checkpoint (Cutting Board + Big Toast)

fly - fly through the game, i am trying to change some ways to be able to fly better

nofly - drop back to the ground to play the game normally
